name: School Wars
source:
Ichijou Shiori is a student at Seiran High School, and the head of the morality club. A case of arson at their rival school, Suzushiro, results in Suzushiro students attending Seiran. Shiori investigates the arson while trying to keep the two groups of students from killing each other.

[edited from [url=http://lijaka.com/blog/2012/07/school-wars/]Lijakaca's blog[/url]]
translation:
一条诗织是星兰高中的学生，也是风纪委员长。敌对学校凉白的一起纵火案导致凉白的学生转入了星兰。诗织在调查纵火案的同时，还要阻止两校学生自相残杀。

[编辑自[url=http://lijaka.com/blog/2012/07/school-wars/]Lijakaca's blog[/url]]
